title: PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels
abstract: arXiv:2611.21160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at

translated_title: PlainPairs：一个将美国处方药标签中面向处方医师与面向患者的文本进行配对的语料库
translated_abstract: 在美国，处方药均附有为处方医师撰写的标签说明，许多药品还附带面向患者的文本：用药指南或患者说明书。这两类文本面向两类读者描述同一种药品，但公开资源很少将它们并列呈现。本文提出PlainPairs，这是一个基于openFDA药品标签文件构建的开放语料库。版本0.1.0包含35,177个附有患者文本的处方标签、21,416个不同的患者文本、通过监管标题与处方医师章节相匹配的250,829个患者文本片段、双方文本的阅读难度测量指标，以及基于规则的白话措辞统计。第二个数据来源——美国国家癌症研究所的癌症信息摘要——新增了756份摘要，涵盖面向医护专业人员和面向患者的版本，并包含英语和西班牙语两种语言。以标签结构来衡量，用药指南的中位数阅读难度按Flesch-Kincaid公式为8.7年级……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了PlainPairs开放语料库，首次将美国处方药标签中面向处方医师与面向患者的文本系统性配对，并附带阅读难度和白话程度等指标，为研究医患健康信息沟通的文本差异提供了公开资源。
en_tdlr: PlainPairs is an open corpus that systematically pairs prescriber-directed and patient-directed texts from U.S. prescription drug labels, with reading-level and plain-language measures, offering a public resource for studying the gap between professional and patient health communication.
